actions.description:
Trigger A hostile creature within 30 feet creates an effect with the auditory trait that provides bonuses to itself or its allies

Effect The melody on the wind recreates the auditory effect, gaining the bonuses for itself and its allies as long as the original effect persists.
actions.name: Hostile Duet
actions.trigger: A hostile creature within 30 feet creates an effect with the auditory trait that provides bonuses to itself or its allies

actions.description:
Trigger The melody on the wind is targeted by a spell with the auditory trait

Effect The melody on the wind attempts to counteract the spell. If it succeeds, the spell effect is caught in a blast of wind that sweeps it back to its origin, affecting the caster. Targets of the triggering effect other than the melody on the wind are still affected normally.
actions.name: Retune
actions.trigger: The melody on the wind is targeted by a spell with the auditory trait

actions.description:
The melody on the wind sings in a sonorous chorus. Any creature in a @Template[emanation|distance:30] must attempt a @Check[will|dc:30] save to resist becoming fascinated by the melody on the wind. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Fascinated for 1 round.

Failure The creature is fascinated for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.
actions.name: Mesmerizing Melody

actions.description: The melody on the wind's movement doesn't trigger reactions.
actions.name: Swiftness

name: Melody On The Wind
publicNotes: This cloud of song and sound has been caught by the wind and carried across the air. While the melody on the wind might enjoy the beauty of music, it is by nature a destructive elemental force.
